walkthroughs.body_html:
Nanoparticles are 1-100 nm across.

They have a large surface area to volume ratio, so less material is needed for catalysis or sunscreens.

Risks: unknown long-term effects on health and environment.

C60 (bucky ball) is a cage molecule - used in drug delivery.

Nanotubes have high tensile strength and conduct electricity.

Both are simple molecular at the smallest scale but with unique properties.

Always link: structure -> bonds or forces broken -> property.

NaCl has a giant ionic lattice; strong electrostatic forces between ions need large energy to break, so mp is high.

Use the words delocalised, lattice, intermolecular precisely.
